name: Dekapan
source:
Most commonly, he is a big-hearted, easy-going man who can be anything from a doctor,a millionaire, a policeman, and so on. He may strive to help out others, although he is also quite eccentric,

Dekapan often laughs or inserts "hoe hoe" as a general verbal tic, and tends to end his speech with "-dasu".
